title: Analista Atuarial Júnior
description:
Somos o Banesprev, um time focado em identificar melhores alternativas para fazer sempre melhor.

Temos Vaga em nosso time de Atuária, então essa é a hora de se juntar à nossa equipe.


Contando um pouco sobre nós...


Estamos como a 7ª maior entidade fechada de previdência complementar do Brasil e sem fins lucrativos.

Nosso objetivo é administrar planos de benefícios complementares de aposentadoria dos funcionários pertencentes à Banesprev, Cabesp e ao Grupo Santander, que é o nosso principal patrocinador.


Qual é a missão da área atuarial dentro do Banesprev:

Apoiar no aprimoramento e na automatização dos processos, revisando/desenvolvendo críticas para análise e validação da base de dados, com a finalidade de assegurar as informações que serão utilizadas para o cálculo do passivo atuarial e relatórios gerenciais.

Apoiar no desenvolvimento de metodologia para acompanhar, monitorar, mitigar e identificar os riscos de cadastro, além de aprimorar a gestão atuarial, em conformidade com as boas práticas de mercado.

Atender as demandas da PREVIC sobre os temas atuariais relacionados aos Planos de Benefícios.

Elaborar relatórios periódicos e contribuir com análises atuariais na tomada de decisão pela alta gestão da Entidade.

Apoiar na análise e críticas de testes de aderência de hipóteses e pareceres atuariais de consultoria atuarial externa.

Assegurar a aderência dos processos à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados – LGPD nos processos da área.


As principais responsabilidades são:


1. Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados

Assegurar a aderência dos processos à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados – LGPD nos processos da área.

2. Dados de participantes e assistidos ao atuário (interno e externo)

Gerar, formatar, analisar, consistir e encaminhar, dados de participantes ativos, autopatrocinados, BPD e assistidos, por meio de planilhas e relatórios, a fim de prover o atuário externo de informações necessárias ao cálculo das reservas matemáticas e avaliação atuarial dos planos e garantir a integridade e qualidade das informações utilizadas na Entidade.

3. Obrigações Legais – PREVIC

Gerar, analisar, consistir e encaminhar à Previc, as informações participantes e assistidos em atendimento à legislação pertinente, além de informações relacionadas aos processos atuariais da entidade.

4. Informações Gerenciais

Elaborar periodicamente relatórios, tabelas e gráficos com o propósito de informar gerência e diretoria sobre os dados relevantes de participantes, assistidos e situação financeira dos planos de benefícios.

5. Procedimentos e Normas

Elaborar/Manter atualizado os manuais de procedimentos e normas operacionais, a fim de preservar a continuidade das atividades atuariais pertinentes.

6. Suporte Gerência e Diretoria

Suportar discussões técnicas com base na legislação vigente e modelos dos planos de benefícios.

Dar suporte interno sobre os impactos atuariais que envolvem os cálculos de benefícios, contribuições e quaisquer outras questões pertinentes aos regulamentos dos planos.

7. Avaliação Atuarial

Sugerir e discutir premissas atuariais com base em estudos de aderência de hipóteses e de taxas de juros, bem como avaliar os resultados das avaliações atuariais elaboradas por consultoria externa.

Conhecimentos técnicos necessários:


  • Superior Completo em Ciências Atuariais.
  • Experiência na área atuarial em entidades fechadas/abertas de previdência complementar e consultorias técnico atuarial.
  • Pacote Office – nível avançado;


Desejável que você tenha:


  • MIBA - Registro no Instituto Brasileiro de Atuária.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos;
  • Inferência estatística.


Competências Organizacionais:


Comunicação; Iniciativa; Trabalho em Equipe; Pensamento crítico; Foco em melhoria de processo; Solução de problemas; Compromisso com a empresa; Foco no Cliente; Compromisso com a qualidade; Flexibilidade e Adaptação; Planejamento e Organização; Criatividade e Inovação; Vontade de Aprender Continuamente;


Competências Técnicas:


Experiência na área atuarial de Entidades Fechadas e Abertas de Previdência Complementar ou Consultorias Técnico Atuarial, conhecimento da legislação de previdência complementar fechada e tributária, inglês básico desejável, habilidade com matemática financeira, noções de contabilidade, habilidade em softwares para análise de grandes volumes de dados.




Detalhes da Vaga - Presencial


Local de Trabalho – Estação São Bento do Metrô, SP (3 min a pé do metrô).


Tipo de trabalho – Tempo Integral / Contrato CLT


Pacote de Benefícios


  • Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Seguro Saúde
  • Seguro Odontológico
  • Plano de Previdência Banesprev
  • Auxílio Creche/Babá
  • Gympass e ginastica laboral
  • Plataforma e-learning de treinamentos

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.


Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

• Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, event-driven architecture and cost optimization

• Experience in IaC development with Terraform/OpenTofu/Bicep/Pulumi

• Experience in container technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

• Experience with SQL development, preferably in a SQL Server environment.

• Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong team player.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

• .NET Core and Entity Framework Core.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Knowledge of arbitrage strategies

• Experience with various financial products such as equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc., and related terminology.

• Experience working with market data (e.g. Bloomberg APIs, etc.).

• Experience with containerization and orchestrators.

• Experience with Test Driven Development.

• Experience with profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the entire stack.

• Experience with NoSQL databases, including document databases and graph databases.

• Angular experience.


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.


Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

• Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, event-driven architecture and cost optimization

• Experience in IaC development with Terraform/OpenTofu/Bicep/Pulumi

• Experience in container technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

• Experience with SQL development, preferably in a SQL Server environment.

• Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong team player.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

• .NET Core and Entity Framework Core.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Knowledge of arbitrage strategies

• Experience with various financial products such as equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc., and related terminology.

• Experience working with market data (e.g. Bloomberg APIs, etc.).

• Experience with containerization and orchestrators.

• Experience with Test Driven Development.

• Experience with profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the entire stack.

• Experience with NoSQL databases, including document databases and graph databases.

• Angular experience.


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Representante Técnico de Campo
description:
Faça parte da revolução na produtividade do canavial brasileiro e impulsione a bioenergia rumo a um mundo descarbonizado!


Estamos em busca de um Representante Técnico que será responsável por executar e acompanhar atividades de campo nos polos de atuação, garantindo a correta operacionalização dos protocolos técnicos relacionados aos programas do CTC ligados a melhoramento genético, produção de mudas e novas tecnologias.

A posição tem papel fundamental na qualidade das execuções, no cumprimento de prazos e na aderência aos procedimentos técnicos e à legislação vigente, atuando com foco em eficiência, organização e confiabilidade dos dados de campo.


Como responsabilidades, esse profissional irá:

  • Executar e acompanhar atividades de campo planejadas nos polos de atuação.
  • Atuar nas etapas de preparo de solo, plantio, avaliações agronômicas, amostragens, coletas e colheitas, conforme protocolos técnicos definidos.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais, padrões de qualidade e prazos.
  • Apoiar a execução de programas de produção de mudas e testes de novas tecnologias. Contribuir para a otimização dos recursos disponíveis (insumos, materiais e tempo), assegurando eficiência operacional.
  • Registrar informações, dados e ocorrências de campo de forma organizada e precisa.
  • Atuar em conformidade com a legislação vigente, normas de segurança e boas práticas agrícolas.
  • Manter interface com equipes técnicas e operacionais, apoiando a fluidez das atividades em campo.


Requisitos:

  • Vivência ou experiência prática anterior em atividades de campo.
  • Bons conhecimentos em operações agrícolas, plantio, manejo, avaliações e coletas.
  • Disponibilidade e interesse em trabalho em campo.


Formação:

Formação superior completa em: Agronomia, Engenharia Agrícola, Engenharia Agronômica, Ciências Agrárias ou áreas correlatas.


Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • Experiência prévia com ensaios agronômicos, experimentação agrícola ou produção de mudas
  • Experiência na cultura da Cana-de-açúcar.


Localização:

Santa Rita, Paraíba (presencial no Polo Japungu)


Benefícios:

  • Participação nos Resultados
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Auxílio Medicamento
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • Alimentação
  • Wellhub


No CTC - Centro de Tecnologia Canavieira , cada dia é uma oportunidade de expandir os limites da genética e do manejo da cana-de-açúcar , desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras para um mundo mais sustentável.


Por que escolher o CTC?

Liderança global em inovação: Estamos na vanguarda das pesquisas com cana-de-açúcar, utilizando as técnicas mais avançadas de melhoramento genético e biotecnologia para criar o mais completo portifólio de variedades.


Infraestrutura de ponta: Nossa sede em Piracicaba (SP) abriga laboratórios reconhecidos como os mais modernos do país. Além de mais de 40 polos de experimentação espalhados pelo Brasil, contamos também com um centro de pesquisa em Saint-Louis (Missouri, EUA).


Equipe apaixonada e dedicada: Nosso time é movido pela ciência e pelo propósito de superar os desafios do setor, garantindo excelência e inovação no campo.


Nossa Cultura:

Colaboração ágil: Atuamos de forma colaborativa, sem perder a agilidade e valorizamos a troca de conhecimento.

Alta performance: Entregamos resultados de muito valor, com alto nível de excelência na execução.

Atitude inovadora: Transformamos ideias em soluções de alto impacto, aplicadas de forma ágil e prática. Estamos sempre em busca de soluções que transformem o agro e coloquem o cliente no centro de nossas ações.

Sucesso do Cliente: Por meio de nossas soluções, geramos valor e resultado para os nossos clientes. O cliente está no centro de nossas decisões e o sucesso dos nossos clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Se você é movido pela ciência, pela inovação e quer causar um impacto real, o CTC é o lugar certo para você . Candidate-se agora e seja parte dessa transformação! Junte-se a um time em pleno crescimento exponencial , onde seu desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional têm espaço para acontecer. Venha construir com a gente um futuro sustentável e descarbonizado.


Somos uma empresa para todos: respeitamos, incluímos e valorizamos!

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.


Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:

title: Closer (Executivo de Vendas)
description:
>>>> CANDIDATE-SE PELO LINK DA VAGA:


-


A Boomer é uma empresa brasileira especializada em mídia de performance para negócios digitais.


Atuamos como parceiros estratégicos de empresas que buscam previsibilidade, eficiência de investimento e expansão sustentável.


Nos últimos anos, consolidamos atuação nacional, atendendo empresas de diferentes portes e níveis de maturidade, sempre com critérios claros de performance e responsabilidade sobre resultados.


Entramos em um novo ciclo de evolução organizacional, com foco na consolidação de uma arquitetura comercial estruturada, previsível e independente de dependências individuais.


Buscamos profissionais que valorizem responsabilidade, consistência, maturidade técnica e compromisso com entrega.


Sede em Uberlândia/MG, com atuação em todo o Brasil.


Sobre a posição:


Buscamos um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas responsável por conduzir processos consultivos com executivos e fundadores, estruturando diagnósticos estratégicos e convertendo oportunidades em contratos da Boomer.


O profissional atuará no modelo de inbound e outbound, com responsabilidade direta sobre:


  • Conversão de leads qualificados em novos contratos;
  • Condução de reuniões estratégicas e diagnósticos executivos;
  • Gestão de pipeline e forecast no CRM;
  • Geração de oportunidades próprias (modelo full cycle);
  • Cumprimento de metas mensais definidas.


A função exige maturidade, organização e responsabilidade por entrega.


Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico com foco consultivo e estratégico;
  • Mapear dores, estágio de maturidade e potencial de crescimento do lead;
  • Construir e apresentar propostas comerciais alinhadas ao diagnóstico;
  • Garantir organização rigorosa do pipeline e previsibilidade de receita;
  • Realizar follow-ups estruturados e disciplinados;
  • Participar de rituais comerciais semanais e revisão de metas;
  • Gerar parte da própria demanda por meio de prospecção ativa qualificada.


Requisitos


  • Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas B2B;
  • Vivência com metas mensais e acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Organização e domínio de CRM (utilizamos Pipedrive);
  • Capacidade de argumentação, negociação e contorno de objeções;
  • Comunicação estruturada e postura profissional em reuniões executivas;
  • Disciplina com rotina comercial e follow-up.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com vendas high ticket;
  • Vivência em empresas com cultura forte de metas e performance;
  • Conhecimento em marketing digital, mídia de performance ou crescimento digital;
  • Experiência com prospecção estruturada (ABM, cadências outbound, etc.).


Perfil comportamental esperado


  • Autonomia para conduzir processos sem dependência constante de liderança;
  • Responsabilidade por resultado e cumprimento de metas;
  • Organização e consistência na execução diária;
  • Postura madura diante de pressão e desafios;
  • Interesse em crescimento profissional proporcional à performance.


Estrutura de trabalho


  • Modelo presencial em Uberlândia/MG;
  • Regime PJ;
  • Remuneração fixa + variável atrelada a performance;
  • Trilha de crescimento estruturada com critérios objetivos.


Benefícios


  • Plano de saúde
  • Descanso Remunerado
  • Auxilio alimentação 
  • Licença de apoio a parentalidade
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Premiação por indicação de colaboradores


Sobre a Contratação


Remuneração: Fixa + Variável

Regime: PJ


  • Vaga Presencial em Uberlândia/MG .

title: Administrador Linux
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!



Perfil: Administrador Servidores Linux

Jornada de Trabalho: De Segunda à Sexta-feira - Presencial

Horário de Trabalho: 09:00 às 18:00

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - SP


Requisitos Profissionais:


  • Formação: Nível Superior em TI;
  • Certificação somente de produtos ativos e com suporte do fornecedor;
  • Certificação: ITIL V4 ou superior;
  • Certificação requerida: LPIC-2 ou Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) ou Suse Certified Engineer (SCE);
  • Certificações desejáveis: LPIC-3 ou Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA) ou Suse Enterprise Architect (SEA);
  • Conhecimentos: Soluções de Backup;
  • Conhecimentos: Nuvem Pública (Azure, AWS, GCP e OCI);
  • Idiomas: Bons conhecimentos em língua inglesa.



Atividades:


  • Análise do ambiente através de métricas (SYSSTAT) garantindo a continuidade do ambiente e sua escalabilidade;
  • Realização de GAPS análises nos ambientes para identificação de falhas na administração e propondo as melhorias aplicáveis;
  • Tarefas gerais de administração: criação de usuários, controle e gestão de permissões de acesso, implantação de rotinas de manutenção (gerenciamento de processos, configuração de rede e de roteamento, instalação de pacotes via gerenciador ou através de código fonte, atualização de sistema operacional, configuração do OpenSSH, agendamentos de tarefas via Crontab, análise de logs, serviços de impressão (CUPS), configuração de logrotate, configuração de firewall Iptables, compilação de kernel etc);
  • Aplicação de atualizações de segurança recomendadas pelos fabricantes dos sistemas operacionais mantendo a estabilidade e correto funcionamento dos serviços hospedados;
  • Assegurar que os dados sejam devidamente armazenados em cópias de segurança (backup), garantindo que estes possam ser restaurados em caso de falhas no ambiente; Atuação em solicitações e alertas de incidentes, executando soluções de contorno e propondo soluções definitivas;
  • Elaboração de rotinas em Shell script para automação de tarefas;
  • Capacity planning de ambientes de servidores Linux;
  • Elaboração de documentação sobre servidores, serviços e ambientes de rede no qual os servidores estão inseridos, detalhando o funcionamento dos serviços e apresentando as topologias correspondentes;
  • Gerenciamento de discos (dimensionamento, particionamento, LVM, configuração iSCSI, FC e Multipath);
  • Gerenciamento de Permissões de arquivo;
  • Particionamento de Discos e FileSystem;
  • Configuração de servidores: SSH, Proxy, Samba\NFS, WEB, DNS, FTP, LDAP, E-mail, Nagios, Grafana e Zabbix;
  • Configuração de certificado SSL;
  • Configuração e administração de containers, kubernetes e Jenkins.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Descrição da Empresa Microlins Ribeirão das Neves.

Descrição do Cargo A Microlins está em busca de um Professor de Inglês dedicado em busca da sua primeira oportunidade para se juntar à nossa equipe em Ribeirão das Neves, MG. A posição consiste em acompanhar aulas presenciais de inglês para estudantes de diferentes níveis de conhecimento. As responsabilidades diárias incluem planejar e preparar aulas, avaliar o progresso dos alunos e aplicar métodos pedagógicos para facilitar a aprendizagem de forma dinâmica e eficaz. Este é um cargo com carga horaria maleável e requer presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Ensino de Inglês : Experiência com a língua inglesa, com habilidades em adaptação a diferentes estilos de aprendizagem de alunos e aplicação prática do idioma.
  • Planejamento de Aulas : Capacidade de desenvolver planos de aula estruturados e dinâmicos que atendam às necessidades educacionais dos alunos.
  • Educação e Ensino : Conhecimento em práticas pedagógicas voltadas para o aprendizado efetivo e engajador.
  • Comunicação : Habilidade de comunicação clara e inspiradora, tanto verbal como escrita, para promover a interação e o engajamento dos estudantes.
  • Diferencial : Formação em Letras com especialização em Língua Inglesa ou certificações de proficiência em inglês (como TOEFL, IELTS, ou CAE) são diferenciais.

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional analítico(a), organizado(a) e com senso de responsabilidade para atuar como Analista de Logística Pleno , integrando a equipe do nosso cliente no setor de serviços logisticos.

Nesta posição, você será responsável por garantir a execução eficiente das operações logísticas ponta a ponta, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, acuracidade de estoque e atualização sistêmica das informações. O profissional atuará com maior autonomia na interface com transportadoras, clientes e equipe comercial.

Responsabilidades

Logística

• Solicitar e negociar cotações de frete junto a transportadoras

• Enviar e acompanhar notas fiscais de venda com as transportadoras

• Coordenar datas e horários de coleta e entrega

• Consolidar materiais em pallets conforme Pedidos de Compra (POs)

• Garantir correta identificação, etiquetagem e organização para expedição

• Monitorar embarques até a confirmação de entrega ao cliente final

• Acompanhar entregas em campo (ex: operações em mina), incluindo controle de DACTE

• Atuar de forma proativa na resolução de ocorrências logísticas

• Atualizar e controlar movimentações de estoque no sistema

• Garantir alinhamento com o time comercial sobre POs programadas

• Monitorar prazos de entrega e status de liberação

• Garantir atualização precisa do estoque disponível (stock-on-hand)

Atividades de Armazém

• Garantir organização, limpeza e padronização do armazém

• Controlar compra de materiais operacionais

• Apoiar melhorias nos processos de armazenagem e expedição

Interface com Cliente e Sistemas

• Monitorar pedidos em sistemas como Nimbi/Coupa e plataformas internas

• Acompanhar sistema V360 para notas fiscais e status de pagamento

• Abrir e acompanhar tickets em caso de inconsistências

• Atuar como ponto de contato para demandas logísticas do cliente

• Garantir atualização de controles internos (Airtable e relatórios de estoque)

Requisitos

• Ensino superior completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas

• Experiência prévia de 2 a 4 anos em logística, supply chain ou operações

• Conhecimento em processos de frete, documentação de transporte e controle de estoque

• Experiência com sistemas de gestão e controle logístico

• Excel intermediário (tabelas, fórmulas, controle de dados)

• Inglês ou Espanhol em nível intermediário (necessário para interface com clientes ou fornecedores internacionais)

• Perfil organizado, proativo e com capacidade de resolução de problemas

Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com clientes do setor de mineração ou industrial

• Conhecimento em DACTE e processos fiscais de transporte

• Vivência com ferramentas como Airtable, Coupa, Nimbi ou sistemas similares

Quem Somos

Talento onde você precisa, quando você precisa!

A SGF Global é uma provedora líder de soluções especializadas em talentos, dedicada a conectar profissionais altamente qualificados com oportunidades em diversos setores. Oferecemos soluções de contratação para posições temporárias, permanentes e de contrato para efetivação em áreas como tecnologia, finanças e contabilidade, engenharia, marketing e criação, serviços jurídicos, suporte administrativo e ao cliente, energia, petróleo e gás, telecomunicações, manufatura, aeroespacial, ciências da vida, mineração e utilidades.

Na SGF Global, trabalhamos para colocá-lo(a) na melhor posição para ter sucesso.

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End
description:
Sobre a OPEN Solutions


Somos a OPEN Solutions , uma empresa inovadora especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções para a indústria, integradas ao SAP ERP . Atuamos com tecnologia em nuvem e integração de sensores no chão de fábrica, levando eficiência, controle e inteligência operacional aos nossos clientes.


Com um time de 31 pessoas e sede em São José dos Campos/SP , transformamos ideias em software que gera impacto real na gestão industrial.


Nosso principal produto, OPEN Manufacturing / OPEN MES , integra PCP e chão de fábrica aos sistemas ERP e APS, apoiando empresas na jornada da Indústria 4.0 .


Nossa visão é ambiciosa: levar nossas soluções ao mercado global e alcançar 17 mil usuários até 2027 .


Oportunidade: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End


Requisitos:

·       Conhecimento em .NET e C#.

·       Noções de bancos de dados relacionais (SQL, SAP HANA) e não relacionais (MongoDB).

·       Conhecimento de APIs RESTful ou GraphQL.

·       Noções de controle de versão com Git.

·       Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e testes automatizados.

·       Familiaridade com arquiteturas de microsserviços.

·       Conceitos de segurança em desenvolvimento back-end.


O que oferecemos:

  • Contrato PJ
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% presencial (localidade: São José dos Campos/SP) - precisa residir na cidade ou região
  • Ajuda de custo: R$ 48,00/por dia útil
  • Wellhub
  • Programa OPEN Mind - 50% do valor de capacitações custeado pela empresa
  • Day-off no mês de aniversário
  • Recesso de 30 dias/ano, sem desconto na remuneração
  • Equipamento de trabalho


Informações adicionais

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.


Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

• Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, event-driven architecture and cost optimization

• Experience in IaC development with Terraform/OpenTofu/Bicep/Pulumi

• Experience in container technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

• Experience with SQL development, preferably in a SQL Server environment.

• Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong team player.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

• .NET Core and Entity Framework Core.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Knowledge of arbitrage strategies

• Experience with various financial products such as equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc., and related terminology.

• Experience working with market data (e.g. Bloomberg APIs, etc.).

• Experience with containerization and orchestrators.

• Experience with Test Driven Development.

• Experience with profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the entire stack.

• Experience with NoSQL databases, including document databases and graph databases.

• Angular experience.


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.


Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

• Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, event-driven architecture and cost optimization

• Experience in IaC development with Terraform/OpenTofu/Bicep/Pulumi

• Experience in container technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

• Experience with SQL development, preferably in a SQL Server environment.

• Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong team player.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

• .NET Core and Entity Framework Core.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Knowledge of arbitrage strategies

• Experience with various financial products such as equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc., and related terminology.

• Experience working with market data (e.g. Bloomberg APIs, etc.).

• Experience with containerization and orchestrators.

• Experience with Test Driven Development.

• Experience with profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the entire stack.

• Experience with NoSQL databases, including document databases and graph databases.

• Angular experience.


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Analista de RH
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um(a) Analista de RH com foco em documentação trabalhista para atuar junto a um de nossos clientes! Essa posição irá atuar em um contrato tercerizado, por tempo indeterminado, em um regime 4x1 no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.


Atividades:

  • Realizar a análise, conferência, organização e envio de documentações trabalhistas exigidas em contratos, garantindo total aderência às exigências contratuais e legais.
  • Atuar no controle das obrigações acessórias (eSocial, FGTS Digital, SEFIP, RAIS, DIRF, entre outras), assegurando prazos e conformidade para evitar retenções de notas fiscais.
  • Acompanhar auditorias e fiscalizações trabalhistas relacionadas aos contratos, atuando de forma preventiva na identificação e saneamento de pendências.
  • Realizar tratativas com áreas internas, contabilidade, jurídico e clientes, garantindo fluxo eficiente de informações e documentos.
  • Operar e atualizar informações em sistemas de gestão e portais (ex.: SIFAC, plataformas de auditoria e ERPs).
  • Manter controles administrativos e relatórios de acompanhamento de status documental dos contratos.
  • Prestar suporte às demandas de Departamento Pessoal relacionadas a admissões, demissões, folha, encargos e benefícios, quando aplicável aos contratos.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com documentação trabalhista.
  • Conhecimento sólido em rotinas de Departamento Pessoal e legislação trabalhista/previdenciária.
  • Vivência com obrigações acessórias e controles que impactam faturamento e liberação de notas fiscais.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão e portais (ex.: SIFAC, plataformas de auditoria e ERPs).
  • Experiência com o setor de petróleo e gás.
  • Perfil organizado, adaptável, proativo e com boa comunicação interpessoal.
  • Desejável: Inglês intermediário

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

A CHC do Brasil busca por um profissinal Mecânico Aviônico .


Estamos em busca de um Aviônico para integrar nossa equipe especializada em manutenção e inspeção de sistemas eletrônicos e aviônicos em helicópteros.


O profissional será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade e segurança dos sistemas embarcados, seguindo rigorosamente os padrões regulatórios e procedimentos técnicos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas aviônicos de helicópteros.
  • Diagnosticar falhas e executar reparos em equipamentos eletrônicos e de navegação.
  • Interpretar diagramas elétricos e manuais técnicos.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas da ANAC e padrões internacionais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de manutenção mecânica e engenharia


Qualificações, Habilidades e Atributos

  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais
  • Formação técnica em Aviônica ou Eletrônica.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de navegação, comunicação e instrumentos de voo.
  • Certificação válida (ex: CHT – Certificado de Habilitação Técnica de Aviônico).


Oferecemos oportunidades de carreira, além de um pacote de remuneração e benefícios.


Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para você fazer parte de um time incrível, em franco crescimento, que mantém os mais altos padrões de qualidade, segurança e excelência em serviços de transporte aéreo.


Vem para o CHC!
